author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Turn on Resolver query logging for your VPCs with an S3 bucket as the destination, and point a Sophos NG-SIEM S3 Ingest (customer-managed) integration at the bucket. AWS writes one JSON record per line. Every query goes to the DNS schema: the name without its trailing dot, the type, class and response code as numbers, the client address, the instance or inbound endpoint as host_id, and the first four answers. The DNS schema has no field for the account, VPC, port, transport or DNS Firewall match, so they stay in original_data, and a query DNS Firewall blocked looks like any other. Reverse lookups get no top private domain. Public hosted zone query logs use a different, space-separated format and aren't covered, and the CloudWatch Logs and Firehose destinations weren't checked. Samples follow the AWS format page and example record with made-up values. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 (76 of 76 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and no built-in parser claimed these lines in 4 Run Tests.
